integrity: A deterministic original-time first-crossing result, with analytic proof; finite standard-library numerical checks are diagnostic only. No claim to a novel phase-portrait classification, global invariant measure, generic saddle-node delay mechanism, or independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Requires strict radial contraction, a finite positive-order angular source zero and a zero-free downstream sector; compact nonzero initial radii and positive integrated source-boundary density. Exponential case has a sharp logarithmic rate, not an exact multiplicative prefactor. No independent expert confirmation of publication priority.
title: Universal first-crossing tails and the complete cubic angular-degeneracy spectrum
